meta.description: Bùi Hoàng Phi — frontend developer building web and mobile products with React, Next.js, React Native and WordPress.

hero.tagline: I build web and mobile interfaces that ship and get used — from WooCommerce stores to React Native apps.

about.label: About
about.bio: I am Phi — a front-end developer with about a year of shipping real products: React and Next.js web apps, a React Native app on Google Play, and WooCommerce stores for clients in Germany.
about.more: I like interfaces that are clean, fast, and where every motion has a reason. Beyond React, I am comfortable with PHP for WordPress/Elementor customisation and with wiring REST and WebSocket APIs alongside the back-end team.

webie-ems-web.summary: Event management web app: a bilingual public site for events, registration and news, plus an admin panel with charts, Excel export, a news editor and maps.

webie-ems-mobile.summary: The mobile app for event guests and staff: QR e-tickets, QR scanning at the door, Google sign-in, and photo and news downloads.

german-woocommerce.summary: IT42life and Reuschenbach: B2C and B2B shopping flows with business account approval, custom PHP logic and product content structured with custom fields.

phjn-coffee.summary: Ordering site for a fictional café: guests scan the QR code on their table to order, and the counter runs orders, menu and tables from an admin dashboard.

vietqr-checkout.summary: A WooCommerce payment gateway: it shows a VietQR code with the amount and order code pre-filled, and marks the order as paid when the SePay webhook reports the transfer.

points: Built the EMS web app and admin panel with React, Vite and Redux Toolkit; lazy loading, code splitting and Puppeteer prerendering for SEO.
Built the whole EMS Mobile UI alone (React Native/Expo): QR e-tickets, QR scanning, Google sign-in; shipped through Google Play closed testing.
Built B2B/B2C flows for German WooCommerce stores and WordPress/Elementor sites, with custom PHP and regular Lighthouse audits.
Learned HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React and Redux through hands-on projects.
Got used to team workflows with Git and code review.
Foundations in data structures, databases and the software development process.
